temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days. When Carolyn asks if she is alright, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is normally engaging, so her recent quietness is uncharacteristic and may indicate something is wrong, though Carolyn does not know the details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn confirms she is overwhelmed by work and personal matters, so Carolyn's concern is validated.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is dealing with work and personal stress; she may need support but has not shared specifics.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer support and a listening ear without pushing Marilyn to disclose more than she wants.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After Carolyn's initial approach, Marilyn was curt in a later interaction, leaving Carolyn confused and slightly hurt. Carolyn then shares her own tough experiences; Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is overwhelmed, but Marilyn's curt response makes her unsure whether she overstepped or whether Marilyn is upset with her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's apology and explanation clarify that her curtness was due to a hard week, not necessarily rejection of Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is having a hard week and appreciates Carolyn's support; the misunderstanding is eased, and Carolyn's support seems welcomed.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially confused and slightly hurt, then relieved, empathetic, and encouraged
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear misunderstandings, show support, and respect Marilyn's boundaries while remaining available.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn previously responded positively to Carolyn's openness. When Carolyn invites her to a small weekend get-together, Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks her, and says she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn feels relieved and hopeful about their budding friendship; she believes Marilyn is warming to her and may welcome a social connection outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's enthusiastic acceptance confirms she is interested in participating in Carolyn's social life.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their friendship is progressing; Marilyn values the invitation and is willing to socialize outside work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To host the gathering and strengthen the friendship with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as still maintaining professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises this directly, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed their friendship was progressing and hoped for more warmth, but she now perceives an unexplained professional distance from Marilyn and feels disappointed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn did not realize the distance and is willing to discuss it, so Carolyn no longer sees the distance as necessarily intentional or personal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: There is a work-dynamic issue to resolve, but Marilyn is cooperative and open to improving collaboration; the distance may be fixable.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed, then cautiously relieved and hopeful
temporal_state_chain.intention: To address the work dynamic directly and work with Marilyn to improve collaboration and clarify boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a private meeting, Carolyn believes they cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries. She proposes teaming up on a new project proposal; Marilyn says it is a great idea, is glad they talked, and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes the earlier work-dynamic issue has been addressed and feels content and optimistic about their ability to understand each other better.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's enthusiastic agreement confirms mutual interest in closer collaboration and reinforces Carolyn's belief that their relationship is on solid footing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: They share a better understanding of expectations and boundaries, and their partnership can grow through the new project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their collaborative partnership.
